name: computer-use-windows
description: Control desktop apps on Windows from any MCP client through a local MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Control Windows apps from an MCP client
interface.longDescription: Windows Computer Use lets an MCP client inspect your desktop with screenshots and UI trees and drive the mouse and keyboard through a local MCP server. Interactive desktop only; cannot control elevated UAC prompts or the secure desktop. Use only on machines you own or are authorized to operate.
defaultPrompt: 用 Computer Use 查看当前桌面并告诉我屏幕上有什么。
用 Computer Use 点击当前应用并报告变化。
用 Computer Use 在活动窗口里填写表单。
